title: I Built an AI Game Development Toolkit & Game Engine (and you can use it too)
author: ajdare
selftext:
This has been my every waking hour for the last 5 months... I think it's coming along nicely, with a lot still planned, available at [https://sorceress.games](https://sorceress.games)   
Basically: it's an ever-expanding toolkit to help make asset creation and AI powered coding smoother and more streamlined for game devs. Hope you guys like and I'm entirely open to feature requests and suggestions - My goal is to make this suite as useful and streamlined as possible.
